map.短螺线管 l≪R 时怎么修正？: How is a short solenoid corrected when l is much smaller than R?
map.长螺线管近似 L=μ₀N²A/l 仅适用于 l>>R；短螺线管用 Wheasto: The long solenoid approximation L = mu_0 N^2 A / l holds only when l is much greater than R; for a short solenoid use the Wheastone or Nagaoka correction factor. map.为何加铁芯电感大增？: Why does adding an iron core greatly increase inductance?
map.磁芯 μᵣ 通常数千，磁导率大幅增加 → L=μN²A/l 倍增；但铁芯饱和后: A core with mu_r usually in the thousands greatly raises the permeability, so L = mu N^2 A / l multiplies; but after the core saturates mu_r falls.
